document.title: Phase 0: Substrate design
document.p: Goal: reviewed public headers for the substrate, a golden module, and CI that enforces the guidelines on every change. No XPath evaluation yet.
Do the tasks in order. Finish each with a commit and a short entry in docs/LOG.md. Stop at the gate.

item.p: 0.1 Build skeleton. CMake (minimum 3.24), C17, include/sxml/, src/, tests/. Presets: debug (ASan + UBSan), , wasm (WASI SDK toolchain file). Compiler flags from docs/C_GUIDELINES.md.
0.2 Test harness. A dependency-free unit test runner in tests/, run by ctest. One trivial passing test.

0.3 Lint gates. Wire .clang-tidy into the build as a target. Add ast-grep rules in tools/ast-grep/ for: banned abbreviations, malloc/free outside src/allocator.c, more than three parameters, bare bool parameters.
0.4 CI. GitHub Actions: Linux (Clang and GCC, debug preset), macOS (Clang), Windows (MSVC, build only), WASI build. Each runs build, lints, tests.
0.5 Core headers (design task). Write, with contract comments, no implementation yet:
include/sxml/memory.h — byte and memory views, sxml_memory_requirements, sxml_allocator interface, checked size arithmetic helpers.
include/sxml/string.h — UTF-8 strings with the ASCII-only flag ().

0.6 Golden module. Implement memory.h fully in src/memory.c and src/allocator.c (default allocator and a test double that counts and can fail allocations), with tests. This module becomes the golden file all later work imitates.
0.7 Substrate headers (design task). Write, with contract comments:
include/sxml/xdm.h — items, sequences (empty, single item, vector, range, lazy), atomic items with type identifiers, function items, maps (), arrays, records.
include/sxml/tree.h — tree interface, node references ( + ), document order across trees. Each object type follows the lifecycle rules: requirements query, initialize/finalize, create/destroy.
0.8 Header self-review. Run the review rubric from docs/C_GUIDELINES.md over every header and fix findings. List open questions at the end of docs/LOG.md.

0.9 Torture slice selection. Choose 100–200 tests from the W3C QT4 test suite that stress the value model (higher-order functions, maps, arrays, JSON, multi-document node order, casting, ranges, try/catch). Record the list in tests/qt4/torture-slice.txt with one line per test explaining why.

section.title: Gate

item.p: Human review of all headers in include/sxml/ completed (agent review, , ).
CI green on all platforms (agent review: run 38931572793 on c4d88fd, after 0.8; local debug, debug-gcc, wasm).
Decisions – in docs/DECISIONS.md confirmed or revised (agent review: recorded, completed by ).

section.p: Only after every gate box is ticked by a human does Phase 1 begin. Per , boxes marked "(agent review)" were ticked by the review agent instead.
